2610.04800.title: MedImageOSWorld: Benchmarking GUI Agents for Medical Image Consoles
2610.04800.paper_summary: Graphical consoles offer a practical interface for medical acquisition assistance, allowing agents to work through the controls and visual feedback used by human operators. Reliable assistance requires linking on-screen anatomy to acquisition decisions that determine what image evidence becomes available next. We introduce MedImageOSWorld, a benchmark for evaluating this capability in simulated CT, MR, and ultrasound consoles. Using screenshots and mouse-and-keyboard actions, agents configure protocols, plan acquisitions, inspect the resulting images, and make corrective adjustments across seven capability levels, from console operation to feedback-driven control. Evaluation combines task-specific workflow checks with hidden anatomical ground truth to assess procedural completion and acquisition outcomes separately. A common evaluation protocol specifies episode conditions and interaction budgets, while recorded trajectories support analysis of how agents observe, act, and respond to acquisition feedback. Across eleven open-weight agents, success rates range from 3.0 to 25.0 on a 0-100 scale while workflow-progress rates reach 21.5-74.5: agents complete much of the console workflow but rarely acquire the intended anatomy. Success collapses between perception and planning, from 79-90% at the lowest three levels for the best agent to at most 12% for millimetre-level planning and 0% for closed-loop control among open-weight agents. Two proprietary agents reach success rates of about 34 and exceed the best open-weight agent mainly in acquisition quality (61 versus 42). MedImageOSWorld provides a controlled setting for studying whether general-purpose GUI agents can translate visual observations into effective medical acquisition decisions.
2610.04800.paper_summary_zh: 圖形控制台為醫療獲取輔助提供了一個實用的介面，使代理能夠通過人類操作員使用的控制和視覺反饋進行工作。可靠的輔助需要將螢幕上的解剖結構與決定下一步可用影像證據的獲取決策連結起來。我們介紹了 MedImageOSWorld，這是一個用於評估這一能力的基準，涵蓋模擬 CT、MR 和超聲控制台。通過截圖和滑鼠及鍵盤操作，代理配置協議、計劃獲取、檢查生成的影像，並在七個能力層級中進行修正調整，從控制台操作到基於反饋的控制。評估結合了特定任務的工作流程檢查和隱藏的解剖真相，以分別評估程序的完成和獲取結果。通用的評估協議規定了事件條件和互動預算，而記錄的軌跡支持分析代理如何觀察、行動和對獲取反饋作出反應。在十一個開放權重的代理中，成功率在 0-100 的範圍內從 3.0 到 25.0，而工作流程進展率則達到 21.5-74.5：代理完成了大部分控制台工作流程，但很少獲取到預期的解剖結構。成功在感知和計劃之間崩潰，最佳代理在最低的三個層級中的成功率為 79-90%，而在毫米級計劃中最多為 12%，在開放權重代理中，閉環控制則為 0%。兩個專有代理的成功率約為 34，並且在獲取質量上超過最佳的開放權重代理（61 對 42）。MedImageOSWorld 提供了一個受控環境，用於研究通用 GUI 代理是否能將視覺觀察轉化為有效的醫療獲取決策。
